lilith.name: Lilith
lilith.title: The Little Sister

passive.name: Thirteen Winters
passive.text: The cold she carries gentles her allies; her healing mends a little more than it should.

lilith.lore: A white-haired, blue-eyed ghost who stopped aging at thirteen. Lilith remembers the shape of a home she can no longer enter and follows her brother because he is the only warm thing left in the world.

assets.reference_role: Design reference sheet. Not a cut-out portrait.
assets.art_note: Playable art extracted from the supplied Project Fantasy concept sheet (tools/extract_lilith_sheet.py -> tools/build_lilith_sheet.py -> tools/build_lilith_static.py): the sheet's own Idle/Walk/Attack/Cast/Hurt/Death strips and Front/Right/Back/Left views, re-laid out as 9 states x 8 directions (72 animations), a 256x384 bust portrait, a 128x192 combat sprite and a 1024x2048 full-body key illustration.

gerald.name: Gerald
gerald.title: The Flamebound Guardian

passive.name: Oath of Ash
passive.text: He has already buried everything but her. The lower his health, the harder he strikes.

gerald.lore: Lilith's older brother. A masked warrior in blackened plate whose seams glow with banked orange flame. He does not speak of the night she died, and the fire answers for him.

assets.reference_role: Design reference sheet. Not a cut-out portrait.
